# stagehand-sdk
> Contract for building Stagehand capability packs (contract_version 1). Preview 0.0.1.

## Read first
- CLAUDE.md: rules and the check loop
- schema/json/manifest.schema.json: the pack manifest
- schema/proto/stagehand/host/v1/host.proto: facets the worker may call (permission strings in comments)
- schema/proto/stagehand/host/v1/worker.proto: services the worker implements
- schema/ts/slots.d.ts: UI slots and props
- examples/hello/manifest.json: a valid headless-plus-tab pack
- docs/pack-author-guide.md: ELI10 walkthrough
